title: Fundamental Capabilities of Large Language Models and their Applications in Domain Scenarios: A Survey
paper_type_zh: 大语言模型基础能力综述
best_for_zh: 比较模型能力、领域需求与评测局限的读者。
one_line: An ACL survey linking fundamental LLM capabilities to their roles in domain applications.
综述大语言模型的基础能力及其在不同领域应用中的作用。
why: It gives readers a way to ask which ability is needed for an application instead of treating model strength as one number.
inclusion_reason: A peer-reviewed survey for relating broad LLM abilities to concrete application settings.

title: Problem
问题
html: LLMs are used in many domains, but a benchmark score does not directly tell a reader which underlying abilities produced success in practice. This ACL survey asks how fundamental capabilities work together in domain applications and how their importance changes across settings.
大语言模型已进入许多领域，但基准分数不能直接说明哪些基础能力让它在真实应用中成功。这篇 ACL 综述讨论基础能力怎样协同，以及它们在不同场景中的重要性如何变化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper reviews domain applications to summarize fundamental capabilities and their collaboration. It then connects capabilities to specific domains and proposes that domain users choose a more robust backbone model using those relationships rather than relying on a single generic evaluation.
论文从领域应用出发，总结基础能力及其协同方式，再把能力与具体领域联系起来。它建议领域使用者依据这种关系选择更稳健的基础模型，而不是只依赖单一的通用评测。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature survey, not a new model recipe. Its method is to collect recent application advances, identify the fundamental capabilities involved, compare their relative importance in domains, and use the resulting map to discuss backbone-model selection.
这是一篇文献综述，不是新的模型训练方案。它汇集近期领域应用进展，识别其中涉及的基础能力，比较这些能力在各领域的相对重要性，并据此讨论基础模型的选择。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper's stated evidence base is recent LLM work in domain applications. Its central empirical caution is that existing benchmark-based evaluation cannot effectively capture real-world application performance, so capability claims need to be read in their domain context.
论文的证据基础是近期大语言模型领域应用研究。它的关键提醒是，现有基于基准的评测未必能有效反映真实应用表现，因此能力结论需要放回具体领域理解。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Rather than cataloguing applications alone, the survey makes the link between abilities and domain success its organizing question. This shifts the comparison from “which model scored highest?” to “which combination of abilities is important for this task?”
这篇综述不只罗列应用，而是把“能力与领域成功之间的联系”作为组织问题。它把比较从“哪个模型分数最高”转为“这个任务真正需要哪些能力组合”。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper does not claim one fixed ranking of capabilities for every domain. The coverage is bounded by the surveyed literature, and a capability-to-domain connection should not be mistaken for a guarantee that a model will work reliably in a particular deployment.
论文并未声称所有领域都有一套固定的能力排序。它的覆盖范围受所综述文献限制；能力与领域的联系也不能被理解为某模型在特定部署中一定可靠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it to make an application requirement list before comparing models. It is useful when a team needs to explain why a domain task needs particular abilities and why a broad benchmark may be insufficient as the sole selection signal.
在比较模型前，可用它先列出应用的能力需求。当团队需要解释一个领域任务为何依赖某些能力，以及为什么不能只用通用基准来选模型时，这篇综述很有帮助。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Start with the paper's capability-domain connections, then test them against the application you care about. Keep separate notes for benchmark performance, the task's operating conditions, and the evidence that the desired capability is actually exercised.

Read the capability map as a hypothesis about an application, not as a substitute for application evidence. Define the task in operational terms, including its inputs, outputs, constraints, and failure consequences. Then identify which fundamental abilities the survey connects to comparable domain work and ask how each ability would be observed in your case. A general benchmark can be informative without being decisive, because it may omit the conditions that make a domain task difficult. Keep one column for a model's reported benchmark performance and another for the evidence that the relevant ability is exercised under your setting. This makes backbone selection a reasoned match between requirements and evidence rather than a choice driven by one aggregate rank.

Use a capability claim only at the level supported by the evidence. If a cited application highlights a combination of abilities, do not reduce it to a single benchmark label or assume that one ability can stand in for the others. Compare models after writing the required capabilities, their relative importance, and the conditions under which they must work. Then ask whether the available evidence actually exercises those conditions. The survey helps organize this reasoning, but it does not make a domain connection a deployment guarantee. A careful reader can use its map to identify missing tests, explain why a generic score is insufficient, and choose a backbone model for stated requirements rather than for a broad reputation alone.

Before making a choice, state what result would count as adequate evidence for the application. This may require task-specific examples or operating conditions that a broad benchmark never presents. The survey can guide that specification by linking domains and capabilities, while leaving the final adequacy decision tied to the reader's actual requirements. It is therefore a framework for sharper questions, not a universal ranking of models.

Write the final judgment conditionally: name the capability combination, the domain conditions, and the evidence used. This preserves the difference between a useful selection rationale and a promise of reliable behavior in every setting. It also makes later revision possible when requirements or supporting evidence change.

Such a record makes model comparison transparent to readers who face the same task later.

It also prevents a broad capability label from replacing the evidence required by a concrete domain decision.

Document the comparison.

先看论文建立的能力—领域联系，再用你关心的应用来检验它。建议分别记录基准表现、任务运行条件，以及目标能力是否真的被使用到的证据。

应把能力图谱视为关于应用的假设，而不是替代应用证据。先用可操作的语言定义任务，包括输入、输出、约束和失败后果；再找出综述与相近领域工作相连的基础能力，并追问这些能力会怎样在你的场景中被观察到。通用基准可以提供信息，却未必具有决定性，因为它可能遗漏让领域任务变难的条件。把模型报告的基准表现与“相关能力在当前设置中确实被使用”的证据分开记录，才能把基础模型选择变成需求与证据之间的合理匹配，而不是只看一个汇总排名。

能力结论只能使用到证据所支持的程度。若某项领域应用强调多种能力的组合，就不应把它缩成一个基准标签，也不能假定一种能力可以替代其余能力。比较模型前，先写下所需能力、它们的相对重要性以及必须发挥作用的条件，再检查现有证据是否真的覆盖这些条件。综述能帮助组织这种推理，却不能把领域联系变成部署保证。细致的读者可以借此发现缺失测试，说明为何通用分数不足，并依据明确需求选择基础模型，而不是仅凭宽泛声誉作决定。

作选择前，应说明什么结果才算对该应用足够的证据。这可能需要通用基准从未呈现过的任务样例或运行条件。综述能通过领域与能力的联系帮助写出这一标准，但最终是否足够仍须回到读者的真实需求。因此，它提供的是提出更精确问题的框架，而不是模型的通用排名。

最终判断也应带条件：写明能力组合、领域条件和所用证据。这样可保留“合理的选择理由”与“在所有场景都可靠的承诺”之间的差别；当需求或支持证据变化时，也便于重新判断。

这样的记录也能让日后面对相同任务的读者透明地比较模型。

它还避免用宽泛的能力标签替代具体领域决策真正需要的证据。

把这种比较记录下来。

value.html: A map between fundamental capabilities, their collaboration, and domain scenarios.
Surveyed primary works; no new trace corpus is released.
Existing benchmark evaluation is discussed as insufficient for fully reflecting real-world application performance.
No universal success predicate is introduced; usefulness depends on the target domain.
Surveyed applications use varied data and feedback.
The official abstract connects fundamental capabilities with domain applications and their varying importance.
Describes a strategy for choosing robust backbone models, not a new training procedure.
